segments.ja396:1.1: Diyaḍḍhakukkū udayena kaṇṇikā, vidatthiyo aṭṭha parikkhipanti naṃ;
segments.ja396:1.3: Sā siṃsapā [sasiṃsapā (sī. pī.), sā sīsapā (syā.), yā siṃsapā (ka. sī. niyya)] sāramayā apheggukā, kuhiṃ ṭhitā upparito [uparito (sī. syā. pī.)] na dhaṃsati.
segments.ja396:2.1: Yā tiṃsati sāramayā anujjukā, parikiriya [pakiriyā (ka.)] gopāṇasiyo samaṃ ṭhitā [samaṭṭhitā (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja396:2.3: Tāhi susaṅgahitā balasā pīḷitā [tā saṅgahitā balasā ca pīḷitā (sī.), tāhi susaṅgahitā balasā ca pīḷitā (syā.), tāhi saṅgahītā balasā ca pīḷitā (pī.)], samaṃ ṭhitā upparito na dhaṃsati.
segments.ja396:3.1: Evampi mittehi daḷhehi paṇḍito, abhejjarūpehi sucīhi mantibhi;
segments.ja396:3.3: Susaṅgahīto siriyā na dhaṃsati, gopāṇasī bhāravahāva kaṇṇikā.
segments.ja396:4.1: Kharattacaṃ bellaṃ yathāpi satthavā, anāmasantopi karoti tittakaṃ;
segments.ja396:4.3: Samāharaṃ sāduṃ karoti patthiva, asāduṃ kayirā tanubandhamuddharaṃ [tanuvaṭṭamuddharaṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja396:5.1: Evampi gāmanigamesu paṇḍito, asāhasaṃ rājadhanāni saṅgharaṃ;
segments.ja396:5.3: Dhammānuvattī paṭipajjamāno, sa phāti kayirā aviheṭhayaṃ paraṃ.
segments.ja396:6.1: Odātamūlaṃ sucivārisambhavaṃ, jātaṃ yathā pokkharaṇīsu ambujaṃ;
segments.ja396:6.3: Padumaṃ yathā agginikāsiphālimaṃ, na kaddamo na rajo na vāri limpati.
segments.ja396:7.3: Na limpati kammakilesa tādiso, jātaṃ yathā pokkharaṇīsu ambujanti.
